project_type: Python CLI tool — SQLite send queue, Gmail SMTP, argparse subcommands
build_system: No build step — plain Python scripts. No setup.py or pyproject.toml.
verification_instructions:
1) Install deps: python3.14 -m pip install dnspython==2.6.1 --break-system-packages
2) Import check: python3.14 -c "import email_verifier; print('OK')"
3) Smoke test verify_email() with kashima@i.kyoto-u.ac.jp (should be valid or unverifiable, never invalid)
4) Negative test with 'not-an-email' (invalid_format) and 'nobody@thisdomain-xyz.invalid' (no_mx)
5) python3.14 mext_sender.py import professors.csv --skip-verify  (no regression)
6) python3.14 mext_sender.py verify-queue --help  (shows --fix)
7) python3.14 mext_sender.py verify-queue  (prints results and summary)
8) python3.14 -m unittest tests/test_sender.py -v  (all existing tests pass)
snapshot_or_generated_files: verify_cache.json — auto-created at runtime by email_verifier.py. Do not commit.
environment_constraints: Python executable is C:\Users\Raja\.local\bin\python3.14.exe. pip install requires --break-system-packages flag. Windows/PowerShell. Do NOT commit any files.
contribution_requirements: Do not touch: email_sender.py, scraper.py, scorer.py, discoverer.py, template.txt, followup_template.txt, llm_client.py, database.py. Do not push or commit.
key_patterns: All subcommands follow pattern: def cmd_X(args) → registered in dispatch dict in main(). Subparsers added in main() with p_X = subparsers.add_parser(...). DB access via functions from database.py (get_connection, update_status, etc). .env loaded implicitly by email_sender.py via python-dotenv; same pattern available for email_verifier.py.
directory_structure: Root: mext_sender.py (CLI), database.py (SQLite), email_sender.py (SMTP), scraper.py, scorer.py, discoverer.py, llm_client.py, config.yaml, requirements.txt, .env, professors.csv, professors.db (SQLite file). tests/test_sender.py. attachments/ (CV PDFs). .agents/tasks/ (planning artifacts).
